chunks: From him, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'The clarified butter (saman) is a medicine, and it is better in the summer than in the winter, and nothing enters the stomach like it.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of clarified butter according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the medicinal properties of clarified butter (samn), emphasizing its seasonal efficacy where it is more beneficial in summer than winter, likely due to climatic influences on digestion and metabolism. This reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of integrating practical health advice with spiritual and physical well-being, viewing food as both nourishment and remedy. The assertion that 'nothing enters the stomach like it' underscores its unique status in traditional Islamic dietary medicine.
